pck_android_mb.note: D-64 (owner): own budget raised to 150 MB (store limits: Google Play base module 200 MB). AAB ~= pck + ~11 MB. Warn at 120 MB.

aab_release_mb.note: D-96: the release AAB (what the store ships), measured in game-android/release-aab; Play base module limit 200 MB. The debug APK (~193 MB, 76 MB debug engine library) is not budgeted.

startup_headless_s.note: median of 5: engine init + autoloads + boot scene + 5 frames, CI runner

lock_scene_headless_s.note: median of 3: plan B lock scene + 5 frames

startup_rss_mb.note: peak RSS of the headless boot (no GPU); proxy for leaks/oversized resources

device.note: D-96 (owner): realistic memory budget for the budget Android class (SM-A165F, 4 GB), measured on device in release builds, docs/handoff/POMIARY.md §10-11. Not checked in CI.
